passages.text: The Medical PPO annual deductible is 750 dollars for an individual and 1,500 dollars for a family, for in-network care in plan year 2026.
The Medical PPO out-of-pocket maximum is 3,500 dollars for an individual and 7,000 dollars for a family; after you reach it, covered in-network care is paid in full.
Preventive care, such as an annual physical, routine vaccines, and screenings, is covered at 100 percent in network with no deductible.
Telehealth visits with the plan's virtual care partner cost a 10 dollar copay and are available at any hour.
The Dental plan annual deductible is 50 dollars per person, and it does not apply to cleanings or other preventive dental care.
Dental orthodontia, such as braces, is covered at 50 percent for children under 19, up to a lifetime maximum of 1,500 dollars.
The Vision plan covers one eye exam every 12 months with a 10 dollar copay, and an allowance of 150 dollars for glasses frames or contact lenses.
Example Co contributes 600 dollars a year to your health savings account (HSA) if you enroll in the Medical PPO high-deductible option; you can add more through payroll.
You can put up to 3,300 dollars a year into a health flexible spending account (FSA); up to 660 dollars of unused money carries over to the next plan year.
Parental leave gives every new parent 16 weeks of fully paid leave, which can be taken within 12 months of the birth, adoption, or foster placement.
Sick leave gives you 10 paid sick days a year for your own illness or to care for a family member.
Example Co matches 100 percent of your 401(k) contributions up to 4 percent of your salary, and the match vests immediately.
New employees are enrolled in the 401(k) automatically at 3 percent of salary after 30 days; you can change or stop your contribution at any time.
Basic life insurance of two times your annual salary is provided at no cost, and you can buy supplemental life insurance during enrollment.
Open enrollment runs each November; outside it, you can change your benefits within 30 days of a qualifying life event such as marriage or a birth.
The wellness stipend reimburses up to 300 dollars a year for gym memberships, fitness classes, or meditation apps.
